create_course.description: Creates a course owned by the user specified in `ownerId` (who is also added as a teacher) and returns the created Course.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the course. For example, "10th Grade Biology". It must be between 1 and 750 characters and a valid UTF-8 string.

params.name: section
params.description: Section of the course. For example, "Period 2". If set, this field must be a valid UTF-8 string and no longer than 2800 characters.

params.name: subject
params.description: Optional. The subject of the course.

params.name: room
params.description: Optional room location. For example, "301". If set, this field must be a valid UTF-8 string and no longer than 650 characters.

params.name: course_state
params.description: State of the course. If unspecified, the default state is `PROVISIONED`. One of: ACTIVE, ARCHIVED, PROVISIONED, DECLINED, SUSPENDED.

params.name: id
params.description: Identifier for this course assigned by Classroom. When creating a course, you may optionally set this identifier to an alias string in the request to create a corresponding alias. The `id` is still assigned by Classroom and cannot be updated after the course is created. Specifying this field in a course update mask results in an error.

params.name: description
params.description: Optional description. For example, "We'll be learning about the structure of living creatures from a combination of textbooks, guest lectures, and lab work. Expect to be excited!" If set, this field must be a valid UTF-8 string and no longer than 30,000 characters.

params.name: description_heading
params.description: Optional heading for the description. For example, "Welcome to 10th Grade Biology." If set, this field must be a valid UTF-8 string and no longer than 3600 characters.

params.name: owner_id
params.description: The identifier of the owner of a course. When specified as a parameter of a create course request, this field is required. The identifier can be one of the following: * the numeric identifier for the user * the email address of the user * the string literal `"me"`, indicating the requesting user This must be set in a create request. Admins can also specify this field in a patch course request to transfer ownership. In other contexts, it is read-only.

params.name: levels
params.description: Optional. Levels for the course. Examples: "9th grade", "Middle school", "4th - 5th", "K-2", "3000". If set, this field must be a valid UTF-8 string and fewer than 1000 characters. This field can only be cleared using the `PatchCourse` method.

params.description: Maximum number of items to return. Zero or unspecified indicates that the server may assign a maximum. The server may return fewer than the specified number of results.

The identifier can be one of the following: * the numeric identifier for the user * the email address of the user * the string literal `"me"`, indicating the requesting user If specified, `student_id` must be empty.

create_course_work.description: Creates course work in a course, associated with the Developer Console project of the OAuth client ID used, and returns the created CourseWork.

params.name: course_id
params.description: Identifier of the course. This identifier can be either the Classroom-assigned identifier or an alias.

params.name: due_time
params.description: Optional time of day, in UTC, that submissions for this course work are due. This must be specified if `due_date` is specified. Keys: hours, minutes, seconds, nanos.

params.name: grading_period_id
params.description: Identifier of the grading period associated with the coursework. * At creation, if unspecified, the grading period ID will be set based on the `dueDate` (or `scheduledTime` if no `dueDate` is set). * To indicate no association to any grading period, set this field to an empty string (""). * If specified, it must match an existing grading period ID in the course.

params.name: scheduled_time
params.description: Optional timestamp when this course work is scheduled to be published.

params.name: title
params.description: Title of this course work. The title must be a valid UTF-8 string containing between 1 and 3000 characters.

params.name: assignee_mode
params.description: Assignee mode of the coursework. If unspecified, the default value is `ALL_STUDENTS`. One of: ALL_STUDENTS, INDIVIDUAL_STUDENTS.

params.name: max_points
params.description: Maximum grade for this course work. If zero or unspecified, this assignment is considered ungraded. This must be a non-negative integer value.

params.name: due_date
params.description: Optional date, in UTC, that submissions for this course work are due. This must be specified if `due_time` is specified. Keys: month, day, year.

params.name: submission_modification_mode
params.description: Setting to determine when students are allowed to modify submissions. If unspecified, the default value is `MODIFIABLE_UNTIL_TURNED_IN`. One of: MODIFIABLE_UNTIL_TURNED_IN, MODIFIABLE.

params.name: topic_id
params.description: Identifier for the topic that this coursework is associated with. Must match an existing topic in the course.

params.name: work_type
params.description: Type of this course work. The type is set when the course work is created and cannot be changed. One of: ASSIGNMENT, SHORT_ANSWER_QUESTION, MULTIPLE_CHOICE_QUESTION.

params.name: materials
params.description: Additional materials. CourseWork must have no more than 20 material items. Keys: youtubeVideo, driveFile, link.

params.name: individual_students_options
params.description: Identifiers of students with access to the coursework. This field is set only if `assigneeMode` is `INDIVIDUAL_STUDENTS`. If the `assigneeMode` is `INDIVIDUAL_STUDENTS`, then only students specified in this field are assigned the coursework. Keys: studentIds.

params.name: description
params.description: Optional description of this course work. If set, the description must be a valid UTF-8 string containing no more than 30,000 characters.

params.name: state
params.description: Status of this course work. If unspecified, the default state is `DRAFT`. One of: PUBLISHED, DRAFT, DELETED.

params.name: multiple_choice_question
params.description: Multiple choice question details. For read operations, this field is populated only when `work_type` is `MULTIPLE_CHOICE_QUESTION`. For write operations, this field must be specified when creating course work with a `work_type` of `MULTIPLE_CHOICE_QUESTION`, and it must not be set otherwise. Keys: choices.
